_comment: The live test models: this file is the only place a live test or smoke gets its model from. TEST_SLOT_<NAME> overrides one slot for one run. Slots: ANTHROPIC_CHEAP = bare hosted-Claude id (served as anthropic/<id>); CODEX_SIDECAR_CHEAP = bare codex id without the persona prefix (the persona is $CODEX_TEST_PERSONA); LOCAL_SMALL = bare claude-local alias of a small local model; LOCAL_EFFORT = bare claude-local alias of the effort-mapping local model; OPENROUTER_ADD_PROBE = the @preset/<slug> id the OpenRouter add probe uses.
